analysis_gate.direction: Lower cached top-1 margin indicates higher drift risk.
analysis_gate.proceed_rule: Proceed to a separately frozen guard threshold and independent holdout only when the runtime signal is separable and all mechanism/validity checks pass.
analysis_gate.separable_definition: At least one paired top-1 flip is observed, every repeated prompt fingerprint has a stable flip label, and the maximum cached margin among all drifted pairs is strictly below the minimum cached margin among all stable pairs.
analysis_gate.stop_rule: If no drift reproduces or cached margin is not separable, preserve the calibration result and do not invent or tune a threshold from the holdout.

candidate_scoring.conditional_normalization_rule: From the returned top 32 entries, aggregate entries whose exact UTF-8 bytes are A, B, C, or D, require all four to be present with positive finite probability, then divide each by their summed raw probability mass. This preserves their logit ordering and equals conditioning the returned distribution on the exact grammar support.
candidate_scoring.observed_b10216_response_boundary: Pinned b10216 returns a top_probs list from the pre-grammar vocabulary distribution even when post_sampling_probs is true; failed native preflight run 30793244346 established this before any cache-on cell or separation result was observed.
candidate_scoring.prediction_rule: Choose the highest conditional A/B/C/D probability; break an exact tie by alphabetical candidate order.
candidate_scoring.raw_probability_retention: Retain the summed raw A/B/C/D probability mass and the count of returned non-candidate top entries for every request.
candidate_scoring.reason_for_temperature_one: The emitted sample is retained but is not the prediction. Temperature 1 preserves candidate logit ordering; the deterministic prediction is the top-1 candidate after the frozen A/B/C/D conditional normalization.

contract.claim_boundary: E10a is calibration evidence for candidate probabilities on the exact selected model, exact E7c native Arm service, sequential one-slot requests, the previously observed eight-task trace, 64 shared tokens, and one, two, or four prefixes. It does not select or validate a serving guard, consume an independent holdout, support a generalized cache policy, or make energy, PMU, local-device, fleet, concurrency, cost, or other-runtime claims.
contract.hypothesis: On the exact E7c native Arm service, known cache-off/cache-on A/B/C/D top-1 flips at the retained 64-token prefix stress point have lower cached top-1 probability margins than every stable paired request, making a separately frozen cache-only fallback threshold testable on an independent holdout.
contract.negative_result_rule: Retain missing probability support, non-reproduced drift, inseparable margins, reference regressions, or mechanism failures without changing tasks, grammar, cardinalities, repetitions, or the separability definition.

prompt_construction.common_filler: Cache followed by the smallest non-negative count of single-token ' cache' repetitions that makes the four-variant tokenized longest common prefix exactly 64 tokens.
prompt_construction.instruction_suffix: Choose the correct option. Respond with only one uppercase letter: A, B, C, or D.
